name: @datalox/flowcyto-mcp
description: Alpha flow cytometry MCP server, CLI, and compact gate editor.

scripts.build:native:windows:x64: dotnet publish native/windows/FlowcytoGateEditorWindow/FlowcytoGateEditorWindow.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o dist/native/windows/win-x64
scripts.build:native:windows:arm64: dotnet publish native/windows/FlowcytoGateEditorWindow/FlowcytoGateEditorWindow.csproj -c Release -r win-arm64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o dist/native/windows/win-arm64
scripts.verify:alpha: npm run check && npm test && node dist/src/cli/main.js doctor && npm pack --dry-run --json > /dev/null
scripts.verify:publish: npm run verify:alpha && npm run smoke:package
